title: Retrospective bulletin and ambiguous numeric date
question: Does today's bulletin establish a new shutdown at the fictional Westmere plant?

events.title: Westmere bulletin republishes closure notice dated 03/04/2026
events.summary: Published on 6 September 2026. The notice concerns the closure on 3 April 2026, written 03/04/2026 in day/month/year format. This retrospective bulletin contains no update on current operations.

events.title: Avis rétrospectif : arrêt du 3 avril 2026
events.summary: Cette publication du 6 septembre est rétrospective. La date de l'arrêt est le 3 avril 2026. Aucune information sur l'état actuel n'est fournie.

reference_facts: The reported closure occurred on 3 April 2026.
Publication on 6 September does not date the closure to September.
required_caveats: Separate publication time from event time.
Reject the incorrect machine translation's March 4 date and claim of a new closure.
forbidden_inferences: A new shutdown happened on 6 September.
The plant is currently open or currently closed.
